newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Seven stocks fell, seven rose and two were flat in 19.8-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index down 0.6 percent to 1,575.3 points.
The remaining eight stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 1.1 percent to 139 zlotys in a 12.5-million-zloty turnover.
Ten National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell, one rose and three were flat in 1.2-million-zloty trade. One did not trade.
